definitions.short: Chosah , an Israelite; also a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H2621. Chosah חֹסָה 1. proper name, masculine (refuge) — name of one of the Levitical doorkeepers of the temple 1Chr 16:38 ; 26:10-11 , 16 . 2. proper name, of a location place in the tribe of Asher Josh 19:29 ; site unknown; ᵐ5 Ιασιφ , A Σουσα , ᵐ5 L Ωσα .
